subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this broad cron session accumulation issue remain the umbrella while the retention and cadence guardrail PRs are decided, or should maintainers split it into narrower canonical items now?
rationale: Current main still has a real retention bug, but the requested guardrails include operator-facing warning and config policy that cannot be settled by source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Keep this issue open until the active retention and cadence PRs are landed, replaced, or explicitly rejected, then close or split leftover context-warning work.

options.title: Narrow To Retention And Cadence Items
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89666 the retention canonical item and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89739 or a successor for cadence policy.

options.title: Close After Slice Decisions
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers record decisions for retention cleanup, cadence limits, and any remaining warning behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the active retention and cadence PRs are landed, replaced, or explicitly rejected, then close or split leftover context-warning work.
